# Urban Links Golf Club

> A private, 24/7 indoor golf club in Fort Thomas, KY, just minutes from Cincinnati. A 3,000 sq ft clubhouse built around one golf simulator bay, a members lounge, and an indoor putting green — capped at 40 members total, with no initiation fee.

Urban Links repositions itself as an indoor country club rather than a simulator-rental business: members get 24/7 PIN-code access, unlimited simulator time, and a year-round calendar of leagues and social events, not an hourly bay rental.

## Pages

- [The Club](https://www.urbanlinksgolf.com/): Overview of the clubhouse (simulator bay, lounge, putting green, meeting space), the club's annual event calendar, member testimonials, and a visit-request form.
- [Membership](https://www.urbanlinksgolf.com/membership/): The two membership tiers, what's included, how to join, and answers to frequently asked questions.
- [Private Events](https://www.urbanlinksgolf.com/private-events/): Full-facility buyouts for corporate outings, bachelor parties, tournaments, and other private events, with an inquiry form.

## Membership tiers

- **Founding Member — $300/month**: 24/7 PIN code access, unlimited simulator time, lounge/putting green/all club events, name on the founders wall. Rate locked for life. Capped at 30 members.
- **The Raccoon Rate — $175/month**: Overnight-only access (12am–8am), unlimited simulator time, lounge and putting green. Capped at 10 members.
- No initiation fee, no assessments, no food-and-beverage minimum. Month-to-month.

## Facts

- Address: 26 N Fort Thomas Ave, Fort Thomas, KY 41075
- Phone: (859) 600-5553
- Email: contacturbanlinks@gmail.com
- Hours: open 24 hours, members only
- Simulator: Uneekor EyeXO 2 with GSPro
- Total membership cap: 40
